reviewer_scope: Review used only the sealed public before views and exact legal menus; it did not view arm identities, selected roots, arm scores, probabilities, or later outcomes.

cases.assessment: The city route needs wheat and ore; trading four ore for wheat shifts the remaining deficit to ore, which the visible board produces more often. END preserves ore for later cities. No connected settlement site is currently open.
